source_refs.note: Roman Urdu solution of the Chapter 8 exercise (PDF 204-206, key PDF 226): MCQs with key and reason, short and long answers, Wazahat boxes where needed.

blocks.text: Exercise mein kitab ke 10 multiple choice, 8 short aur 5 long questions hain. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab aur us ki wajah chapter ke text se di gayi hai; kitab ke aakhir wali answer key 10 mein se 8 sawalon mein text se mel nahi khati, wahan "Kitab ki ghalti" box hai. Short aur long sawalon ke jawab imtihan ke andaz mein hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. Which of the following is a key component of digital literacy?
(Digital literacy ka key component kaunsa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Digital literacy yani computer, smartphone aur internet jaise digital tools ko maloomat dhoondne, samajhne, banane aur share karne ke liye istemal karne ki salahiyat (8.1.3).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (d) public speaking deti hai, jo 8.1.4 ke components mein nahi. Digital literacy digital tools ke achhe istemal ka naam hai, is liye jawab (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Which Boolean operator would you use to exclude a term from search results?
(Search results se koi lafz nikalne ke liye kaunsa Boolean operator?)
blocks.explanation: NOT kisi lafz ko search results se nikalne ke liye hai, maslan “Farming NOT pesticides” (8.1.5). AND dono lafz shamil karta hai, OR koi bhi aik.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (a) OR deti hai, lekin OR to dono mein se koi bhi lafz wale results deta hai; lafz nikalne ka kaam NOT karta hai (8.1.5), is liye jawab (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Which skill is essential for evaluating online sources effectively?
(Online sources ko parakhne ke liye kaunsi skill zaroori hai?)

options.text: Checking if the content is from a trusted entity

blocks.explanation: Sources parakhne ka matlab hai check karna ke maloomat reliable hai, yani kisi bharose wale idare (trusted entity) jaise university ya credible organization se aayi hai (8.1.4).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (b) "content banane wale ka naam jaanna" deti hai. Sirf naam jaan lena reliability sabit nahi karta; text kehta hai dekhein ke content bharose wale source se hai (8.1.4), is liye jawab (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Why is it important to be specific when formulating a research question?
(Research question banate waqt specific hona kyun zaroori hai?)

options.text: To ensure it covers a wide range of topics
To clearly define what you want to find out and avoid vague questions
To include as much information as possible
To make the research more generalizable

blocks.explanation: Specific sawal wazeh karta hai ke aap kya jaanna chahte hain aur research ko aik rukh deta hai; vague (gol mol) sawal se research bikhar jati hai (8.2).

blocks.prompt:
5. What does it mean when an article is “peer-reviewed”?
(Article ke “peer-reviewed” hone ka matlab?)

options.text: It is edited by a single expert
It is published in a magazine
It is reviewed by other experts in the field

blocks.explanation: Peer-reviewed article ko chhapne se pehle usi field ke doosre experts ne check kiya hota hai, is liye woh bharose ke qabil hota hai (8.3.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (b) "magazine mein chhapa" deti hai. Text ke mutabiq peer-reviewed ka matlab doosre experts ki jaanch hai (8.3.1), is liye jawab (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Which of the following is a key purpose of online libraries?
(Online libraries ka aham maqsad?)

options.text: Offering a variety of academic resources

blocks.explanation: Online libraries aur research databases academic resources (journals, research papers) ka khazana muhaiya karti hain (8.3.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (a) entertainment deti hai. Text kehta hai online libraries academic resources deti hain (8.3.1), is liye jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Which of the following is an essential component of ethical research?
(Ethical research ka zaroori hissa?)

options.text: Collecting as much data as possible regardless of participants' privacy
Avoiding plagiarism and providing proper credit
Publishing results only if they are positive
Ignoring participant consent if the research is important

blocks.explanation: Ethical research mein plagiarism se bacha jata hai aur asal kaam karne wale ko credit diya jata hai; data badalna ya bina credit copy karna unethical hai (8.4.1).

blocks.prompt:
8. Which principle of research ethics focuses on being truthful and transparent in reporting findings?
(Nateeje ko sachai aur transparency (kuch na chhupana) se report karna kis usool mein aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Integrity (imandari) ka matlab hai research mein sach aur transparency: data na badalna, plagiarism na karna aur nateeje ghalat pesh na karna (8.4.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (a) Confidentiality deti hai, jo participants ki maloomat raaz rakhne ka naam hai. Sach aur transparency se report karna Integrity hai (8.4.2), is liye jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. Which of the following is NOT a type of intellectual property?
(Kaunsi intellectual property ki qisam NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Intellectual property zehan ki takhleeqat (creations) ki hifazat hai; is ki qismein patents, trademarks, copyrights, industrial designs aur trade secrets hain. Physical properties is mein shamil nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (b) Trademarks deti hai, halanke trademark to intellectual property ki aik qisam hai. Jo IP NAHI woh (d) Physical Properties hai.

blocks.prompt:
10. How can a company protect a trade secret?
(Company trade secret kaise bachaye?)

options.text: By registering it with the IPO
By keeping the information confidential and using legal agreements
By publishing it in a scientific journal

blocks.explanation: Trade secret ki hifazat maloomat ko raaz rakh kar aur legal agreements (confidentiality agreements) se hoti hai (8.5.3); patent ki tarah ise public nahi kiya jata.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (b) trademark deti hai, jo brand ke naam ya logo ki hifazat karta hai. Text ke mutabiq trade secret raaz rakh kar aur legal agreements se bachaya jata hai (8.5.3), is liye jawab (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. How can one ensure the reliability of information found through online research?
(Online research se mili maloomat ke reliable hone ka yaqeen kaise karein?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Reliable sources istemal karein: official government websites, taleemi idare aur mashhoor akhbarat.
2. Dekhein content kis ne banaya aur kya woh idara bharose wala hai.
3. Aik hi baat kai reliable sources mein check karein (fact-checking).
4. Dekhein maloomat taza hai ya nahi (date ka filter lagayein).

blocks.prompt:
2. Why is it important to evaluate the reliability of online sources?
(Online sources ki reliability parakhna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Internet ki har maloomat sahi nahi; kuch websites jhooti ya gumrah karne wali baatein deti hain.
Parakhne se maloomat sahi rehti hai aur homework aur research mein ghalat nateeje nahi nikalte.
Faisle soch samajh kar hote hain aur hum ghalat maloomat nahi phailate.

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain the difference between exploratory and explanatory research questions.
(Exploratory aur explanatory research questions mein farq bataiye.)
blocks.explanation: Exploratory sawal naye topic mein dekhta hai ke kya ho raha hai; explanatory sawal batata hai ke aisa KYUN hota hai. (Chapter se bahar: kitab sirf in ka naam leti hai.)

rows: Naye ya kam samjhe gaye topic ko khojta (explore) hai
Batata hai ke koi cheez KYUN hoti hai
Maqsad: pata lagana ke kya ho raha hai
Aksar hypothesis se test hota hai
Misal: "Class XI ke students parhai ke liye social media kaise istemal karte hain?"
Misal: "Kya nashta karne se morning classes mein energy barhti hai?"

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: exploratory = "kya ho raha hai?"; explanatory = "aisa kyun ho raha hai?" (jaise doctor bukhar ki wajah dhoondta hai).

blocks.prompt:
4. Explain the importance of hypothesis in research process.
(Research process mein hypothesis ki ahmiyat bataiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Hypothesis aik saaf aur test ho sakne wala bayan (statement) hai jo research question ke jawab ki peshgoi karta hai.
Yeh research ko rukh deta hai aur tay karta hai ke kaunsa data jama karna hai.
Saboot use support ya reject karte hain, is se saaf nateeja nikalta hai.
Misal: "Jo students nashta karte hain un ki morning classes mein energy zyada hoti hai." (Chapter se bahar.)

blocks.prompt:
5. Why is it important to use specific keywords when searching for information online?
(Online search mein specific keywords kyun zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Specific keywords se mutalliqa (relevant) results jaldi milte hain; aam alfaaz se bohat se ghair-zaroori results aate hain.
Waqt bachta hai, aur inhein Boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT) aur filters ke saath mila sakte hain.
Misal: sirf "farming" ke bajaye "organic farming".

blocks.prompt:
6. How can a researcher avoid bias in their study?
(Researcher apni study mein bias se kaise bache?)
blocks.explanation:
Research insaf se karein aur nateeje sirf jama kiye gaye saboot par rakhein.
Nateeje imandari se batayein, chahe umeed ke mutabiq na hon; data na badlein na chhupayein.
Kai sources aur viewpoints dekhein, sirf apni raaye wale nahi, aur sab participants se insaf karein.

blocks.prompt:
7. Describe the purpose of a trademark.
(Trademark ka maqsad bataiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Trademark aik nishan, logo ya naam hai jo aik company ke saman ya services ko doosron se alag karta hai.
Is se customer product ki company pehchanta hai aur brand recognition (pehchan) banti hai.
Register karwane par koi doosra wohi naam, logo ya slogan istemal nahi kar sakta, jaise National Foods ka logo.

blocks.prompt:
8. How does copyright differ from patent protection?
(Copyright patent ki hifazat se kaise alag hai?)
blocks.explanation: Copyright takhleeqi kaam (kitab, software waghera) ki hifazat karta hai; patent invention (ijad) ki.

rows: Literary aur artistic kaam (kitab, music, film, software) ki hifazat
Invention (ijad) yani naye product, process ya technical hal ki hifazat
Sirf author kaam publish, sell ya adapt kar sakta hai
Kuch saalon tak koi aur inventor ki ijazat ke baghair invention bana, istemal ya bech nahi sakta
Munasib idare ke paas register kar ke bachaya jata hai
IPO Pakistan se apply kar ke milta hai

blocks.prompt:
1. Discuss the different types of online research and their purposes, providing examples for each type.
(Online research ki alag alag qismein aur un ke maqsad misalon ke saath bataiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Online research yani internet par kisi topic ke baare mein maloomat dhoondna, jaise articles, reports ya videos se. Maqsad ke lihaz se is ki qismein (8.1.2):
1. General Information Research
Maqsad: kisi topic ki bunyadi maloomat aur khaas points jaanna.
Misal: Google par renewable energy ke baare mein articles, blogs ya videos dekhna.
2. Academic Research
Maqsad: taleem ke liye ilmi (scholarly) maloomat; yeh tafseeli aur reliable hoti hai, aksar experts ki likhi hui.
Misal: Google Scholar ya university ki online library mein pollution ke asraat par journal articles dhoondna.
3. Market Research
Maqsad: karobar aur entrepreneurs market trends, customers ka rawayya aur muqabla samajhte hain, phir naya product launch karte hain.
Misal: naya juice brand shuru karne se pehle doosre brands ke reviews aur trends dekhna.
4. Fact-Checking Research
Maqsad: kai reliable sources se check karna ke maloomat sahi hai.
Misal: viral khabar ko share karne se pehle government websites aur mashhoor akhbarat se milana.
5. Health Research
Maqsad: bimariyon, ilaj aur health services ki maloomat reliable health websites aur medical journals se lena.
Misal: official health website se dengue ki alamaat aur bachao parhna.
Har qisam mein maqsad sahi, bharose wali aur taza maloomat hai, is liye sources reliable hon aur aapas mein milaye jayein.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain the concept of digital literacy and its key components. How does it contribute to effective use of digital tools and resources?
(Digital literacy aur us ke key components samjhaiye. Yeh digital tools aur resources ke achhe istemal mein kaise madad deti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Digital literacy yani computer, smartphone aur internet jaise digital tools ko maloomat dhoondne, samajhne, banane aur share karne ke liye istemal karne ki salahiyat (8.1.3).
Key components (8.1.4):
1. Using Technology: computer, tablet, smartphone chalana; programs kholna, apps aur websites istemal karna. Misal: word processing software mein school report type aur format karna.
2. Searching for Information: search engine mein munasib keywords likh kar results ko behtar karna. Misal: Punjab ka kisan "modern irrigation techniques for wheat" search karta hai.
3. Evaluating Sources: dekhna ke maloomat reliable hai: kis ne banayi aur source bharose wala hai. Misal: Lahore ka teacher check karta hai ke website kisi taleemi idare ki hai.
4. Creating Digital Content: apna material banana, jaise article, presentation ya photo editing. Misal: Karachi ka student PowerPoint presentation banata hai.
5. Online Safety and Privacy: mazboot password aur khatron ki pehchan se personal maloomat bachana. Misal: Islamabad ka shakhs privacy settings lagata hai aur shak wale link nahi kholta.
Digital tools ke achhe istemal mein madad:
- Log tools aitmaad se chalate hain aur sahi maloomat jaldi dhoondte hain.
- Reliable sources chunte hain aur jhooti maloomat se bachte hain.
- Parhai aur kaam ke liye apna content banate aur share karte hain.
- Online mehfooz rehte hain aur apna data bachate hain.
Yun digital literacy students ko homework, professionals ko taza maloomat aur sab ko soch samajh kar faisle mein madad deti hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain the process of developing a clear and focused research question. Illustrate your answer with examples of well-formulated and poorly-formulated research questions.
(Wazeh aur focused (ek baat par tika hua) research question banane ka tareeqa achhi aur kharab misalon ke saath samjhaiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Research inquiries banana yani aise sawal banana jo research ko rasta dikhayein aur batayein ke hum kya seekhna chahte hain (8.2). Achha sawal saaf, specific aur focused hota hai, vague (gol mol) nahi.
Research question banane ka tareeqa (kitab ki Class Activity aur aam qadam; tafseel chapter se bahar):
1. Aisa topic chunein jis mein dilchaspi ho, maslan khurak ka students ki energy par asar.
2. Online thori background parhai karein ke pehle se kya maloom hai.
3. Topic ko aik pehlu tak mehdood karein: kaun (kaunsa group), kahan aur kya.
4. Specific sawal likhein jis ka jawab jama kiye ja sakne wale data se mil sake.
5. Check aur behtar karein: saaf hai? bohat bara ya bohat chhota to nahi?
6. Test ho sakne wala hypothesis banayein, phir study ka design sochein.
Misalein:
- Kharab: "Kya social media bura hai?" (vague, bohat wasee, sirf raaye)
  Achha: "Rozana social media par guzara waqt Lahore ke Class XI students ke parhai ke ghanton par kya asar dalta hai?"
- Kharab: "Khurak ka kya?" (koi focus nahi)
  Achha: "Kya nashta karne se college students ki morning classes mein energy par asar parta hai?"
- Kharab: "Grades alag kyun hain?" (bohat aam)
  Achha: "Kya extracurricular activities hamare college ke Class XI students ke grades par asar dalti hain?"
Achha sawal kamyab research ka pehla qadam hai; yahi poori study ka rukh tay karta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Achhe research question ko GPS ka pata samjhein. "Lahore" likhenge to GPS kahin bhi le jayega (vague). "Lahore, Mall Road, GPO" likhenge to seedha manzil par (specific). Isi tarah sawal mein kaun, kahan aur kya wazeh ho to research seedhi manzil tak pohanchti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Discuss the importance of research ethics in maintaining the credibility and reliability of research findings. Explain how unethical practices could affect the research community and society.
(Research ethics nateeje ki credibility aur reliability ke liye kyun aham hain? Unethical tareeqe research community aur society par kya asar dalte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Research ethics woh usool aur hidayat hain jin par chal kar researcher ka kaam imandar, izzat wala aur munsifana hota hai; yeh participants, research community aur society ke huqooq aur behtari ki hifazat karte hain (8.4).
Credibility (saakh) aur reliability ke liye ahmiyat (8.4.1):
1. Nateeje bharose ke qabil hote hain kyunke data imandari se jama aur report hota hai.
2. Shamil logon ke huqooq ki izzat hoti hai.
3. Researcher nuqsan, ghalat maloomat aur na-insafi se bachta hai.
4. Nateeje credible aur reliable bante hain aur doosron ke kaam aate hain.
Aham usool (8.4.2):
- Informed Consent: participants ko maqsad bata kar ijazat lena.
- Confidentiality: un ki maloomat aur jawab raaz rakhna.
- Integrity: imandari aur transparency; data na badalna, plagiarism na karna, nateeje ghalat pesh na karna.
- Respect for Participants: sab ki izzat, kisi ko nuqsan nahi.
- Avoiding Bias: insaf aur nateeje sirf saboot par.
Misal: social media aur classmates ki parhai par survey mein pehle ijazat lein aur jawab raaz rakhein.
Unethical kaam ke asraat:
Research community par:
- Jhoota data aur plagiarism ghalat nateeje dete hain; jo researchers in par kaam karte hain un ka waqt aur paisa zaya hota hai.
- Research par bharosa khatam hota hai aur researcher ki saakh kharab hoti hai.
Society par:
- Ghalat maloomat phailti hai aur log nuqsan wale faisle kar sakte hain, maslan sehat ke baare mein.
- Participants ko nuqsan ya privacy ki khilaf warzi hoti hai, phir log research par bharosa aur hissa lena chhor dete hain.
Is liye ethical research bharosa banati hai aur society ko faida deti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Research ko imtihan ki tarah samjhein: agar koi nakal kar ke ya number badal kar pass ho jaye to us ka result kaghaz par achha hai magar asal mein bekaar. Isi tarah jhoota data wali research par koi doctor ya engineer bharosa kare to nuqsan sab ka hota hai. Is liye ethics (consent, confidentiality, integrity, respect, no bias) yaad rakhein.

blocks.prompt:
5. Discuss the various types of intellectual property and provide examples of each. Explain how each type helps in protecting different kinds of creations and innovations.
(Intellectual property ki alag alag qismein misalon ke saath bataiye, aur har qisam kis tarah ki cheezon (creations) ki hifazat karti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Intellectual Property (IP) woh qanooni huqooq hain jo zehan ki takhleeqat (creations of the mind) ki hifazat karte hain, jaise inventions, adabi aur fanni kaam, designs, nishan, naam aur tasveerein; in se creator apne kaam par ikhtiyar rakhta aur faida uthata hai (8.5).
Qismein (8.5.1):
1. Patents: invention (naya product ya process ya naya technical hal) ka khaas haq; doosre bina ijazat bana, istemal ya bech nahi sakte.
Misal: Pakistani engineer zyada behtar solar panel ka patent leta hai; kuch saal sirf wohi bana aur bech sakta hai.
Hifazat: ijadat aur technical innovations ki.
2. Trademarks: nishan, logo ya naam jo aik company ke saman ko doosron se alag kare.
Misal: masalon par National Foods ka logo.
Hifazat: brand ki pehchan; koi aur brand copy nahi kar sakta.
3. Copyrights: kitab, music, film, painting aur software jaise kaam; creator ko istemal, distribute aur license ka khaas haq.
Misal: Pakistani author ka novel sirf wohi chhap, bech ya film bana sakta hai.
Hifazat: takhleeqi kaam ko copy hone se.
4. Industrial Designs: cheez ki shakal, banawat aur khoobsurti ki hifazat.
Misal: Karachi ke designer ki mineral water bottle ki khaas shakal doosri companies istemal nahi kar saktin.
Hifazat: product ki woh shakal jo use munfarid aur pur-kashish banati hai.
5. Trade Secrets: raaz wali karobari maloomat jo muqable mein bartari de; public nahi ki jati, confidentiality agreements se bachayi jati hai.
Misal: Pakola ki recipe, jo company mein sirf chand log jaante hain.
Hifazat: khufia tareeqe, formulas aur maloomat.
Hifazat kaise (8.5.3): patent IPO Pakistan se; trademark register karwayein; copyright munasib idare ke paas register; trade secret raaz rakhein aur legal agreements karein.
Ahmiyat (8.5.2): IP se creator ko apni mehnat ka faida milta hai, aur log naye ideas aur innovation ki taraf barhte hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aik hi product mein kai IP ho sakti hain. Maslan aik mobile phone: andar ki nayi technology patent hai, company ka naam aur logo trademark hai, phone ka software copyright hai, phone ki khaas shakal industrial design hai, aur banane ka koi khufia tareeqa trade secret hai. Is misal se paanchon qismein aasani se yaad rehti hain.
